d: A straight sleeve block (sleeve sloper) drafted with the classic British Bray method

bicepEase.d: How much ease to add to the upper arm to get the width of the sleeve root. The book allows 5 cm for skirts and blouses, 6 to 7 cm for shirts and jackets, and 8 cm for coats and eveningwear

capHeight.d: How deep the sleeve cap is, as a fraction of the sleeve root width. The book draws it at about a third or a little more; a higher cap gives a narrower, less comfortable sleeve
